tldr: The U.S. and Canada have entered a trade war following the collapse of trade talks, with both nations imposing retaliatory tariffs on each other's goods.
Global markets reacted to ongoing geopolitical tensions, including the intensification of U.S. sanctions on Iran and renewed clashes between Israel and Palestine.
New scientific findings highlight potential breakthroughs in treating skin cancer with mRNA vaccines and uncover toxic chemicals in personal care products.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed higher, with the S&P 500 up 33.21 points to 7674.37 and the Nasdaq Composite up 113.29 points to 26180.46 as of August 21, 2026. Market movements were influenced by various global and domestic events.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose 0.04% to 4.74% as of August 21, 2026. Rising yields can be attributed to ongoing concerns about U.S. debt and inflation, as well as geopolitical tensions impacting global markets.

vix.why: The VIX, or CBOE Volatility Index, decreased by 0.88 to 15.13 as of August 21, 2026, indicating a slight reduction in market fear or expected volatility.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 6.65% as of August 20, 2026, a decrease of 0.02% from the previous weekly survey. Mortgage rates have historically tracked Treasury yields, and while the latest weekly survey indicates a slight decrease, broader market trends and the direction of yields over recent days are the primary drivers.

policy.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Wi-Fi 8 is presented not as a speed upgrade, but as a system designed to improve home network performance, addressing a need beyond just faster data transfer.
The development of JIT (Just-In-Time) compiling code has achieved execution times as low as 5 microseconds, showcasing significant advancements in performance optimization.
A new tool called Figmimic allows users to copy any webpage into Figma as editable layers, streamlining the design workflow.

world.summary: The U.S. and Canada have entered a trade war following the collapse of trade talks, with both nations imposing retaliatory tariffs on each other's goods, impacting items ranging from hockey sticks to tongue depressors.
Iran's president has acknowledged the country faces 'many problems' as the U.S. intensifies sanctions, with Tehran warning that countries supporting U.S. economic measures will be considered enemies.
Dozens of coordinated arson attacks have occurred in southern Thailand, with the military suggesting the incidents aim to create unrest, though no group has yet claimed responsibility.

us.summary: A judge ruled that the Trump administration's visa ban targeting citizens from 75 countries was illegal and discriminatory on the basis of nationality.
The Trump Administration has released a two-year operating plan for the Colorado River, which is expected to lead to significant water use cuts for Arizona, California, and Nevada.
The body camera footage of a federal agent's shooting of Jonah Neal, who was experiencing a mental health crisis, has been described as 'unjustified' by the family's attorney.

science.summary: A new mRNA vaccine for melanoma demonstrated success in late-stage trials, indicating a potential to significantly reduce the recurrence and spread of skin cancer.
A study found that common personal care products, including those marketed as 'natural' or 'green,' can contain unlabeled toxic chemicals such as PFAS.

weekly_recap: Global markets experienced a downturn this week, influenced by geopolitical tensions, escalating U.S. sanctions on Iran, and stalled U.S.-Iran peace talks. The U.S. and Canada entered a trade war after failing to reach an agreement, with both imposing retaliatory tariffs. In science, a new mRNA vaccine for melanoma showed promising results in late-stage trials, and a study revealed the presence of toxic chemicals in personal care products. Next week, attention will likely remain on the unfolding trade disputes and any further developments in international relations.
